description: OpenBrowser - local desktop fingerprint browser: isolated Chromium profiles, proxy/fingerprint/extension control, batch management, window sync, local RPA, Local API + MCP (127.0.0.1:50325).
pre_install: Get-Process OpenBrowser -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "$dir*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $sub = Get-ChildItem "$dir" -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^OpenBrowser-' }; foreach ($s in $sub) { Move-Item "$($s.FullName)/*" $dir -Force; Remove-Item $s.FullName -Force -Recurse }; $mf="$dir/runtime/resources/app/main.js"; if(Test-Path $mf){$c=Get-Content -Raw $mf;$n="return pathToFileURL(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html')).href;";$r="try { return pathToFileURL(fs.realpathSync(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html'))).href; } catch (_) { return pathToFileURL(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html')).href; }";if($c.Contains($n)-and -not $c.Contains("fs.realpathSync(path.join(__dirname, 'index.html'))")){$c=$c.Replace($n,$r);[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($mf,$c)}}
post_uninstall: Get-Process OpenBrowser -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like "*$dir*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
notes: Local API/MCP on 127.0.0.1:50325. Bundled Wayfern kernel works out of the box; to use the C++ fingerprint kernel, set OpenBrowser's kernel path to <scoop dir>\fingerprint-chromium\current\chrome.exe. Launch with 'OpenBrowser' from PATH.
